e.title: RNA R3S
e.summary: 非寿险风险平台（RNA Analytics）：ORSA/偿付能力报告的自动化行业代表
e.body:
RNA Analytics 的 R3S 是非寿险风险平台：ORSA（自有风险评估）、偿付能力资本与风险分析一体化，把监管合规报告从手工转为自动化。对 RIAA：ORSA 报告自动化的行业标杆——站内 [[orsa]]/[[rbc]] 概念的商用实现；与 [[openirm]]（Solvency II 开源实验台）形成「商用 vs 开源」对照；精算就业（ORSA 团队）的必备软件认知。

## 同类工具
[[security-decision-labs]]、[[smarp]]、[[splice]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Non-life risk platform (RNA Analytics): ORSA / solvency reporting automation industry representative
e.summary_hk: 非壽險風險平台（RNA Analytics）：ORSA/償付能力報告的自動化行業代表
e.body_en:
RNA Analytics' R3S is a non-life risk platform: ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment), solvency capital and risk analytics unified, turning regulatory compliance reporting from manual into automated. For RIAA: the industry benchmark for ORSA-report automation — a commercial implementation of the site's [[orsa]]/[[rbc]] concepts; with [[openirm]] (open-source Solvency II bench) it forms a commercial-vs-open-source contrast; essential software awareness for actuarial careers (ORSA teams).

## Similar tools
[[security-decision-labs]]、[[smarp]]、[[splice]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
RNA Analytics 的 R3S 是非壽險風險平台：ORSA（自有風險評估）、償付能力資本與風險分析一體化，把監管合規報告從手工轉為自動化。對 RIAA：ORSA 報告自動化的行業標杆——站內 [[orsa]]/[[rbc]] 概念的商用實現；與 [[openirm]]（Solvency II 開源實驗台）形成「商用 vs 開源」對照；精算就業（ORSA 團隊）的必備軟件認知。
